title: Synthetic-Neuroscore: Using A Neuro-AI Interface for Evaluating Generative Adversarial Networks
reasoning: The paper introduces a novel metric (Neuroscore) for evaluating Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) based on human psychoperceptual image quality, measured through brain signals. It compares this metric to traditional evaluation methods and demonstrates its consistency with human judgment regarding image quality. The focus is on technical evaluation of image generation, not on assessing moral, ethical, or religious aspects. Mentions of 'ethics approval' are procedural for data collection, not an evaluation component.
